title: Qt: Enabled Protocols: Let enabled and name/description be orthogonal
description:
Allow selecting whether to search in the protocol name and/or
description, and among enabled and/or disabled protocols separately,
as they're orthogonal. Make the Enum into a flag type and use QFlags.

Fix #21123

AI-Assisted: no
